mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate at or below 0.2% compresses discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS is at or below 0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPIAUCSL increase exceeding 0.5 percentage points signals inflation acceleration, triggering Fed policy tightening that reduces equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL rises by >0.5% monthly.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and GDP growth (GDPC1) indicate weakening consumer demand, triggering equity market sell-offs that yield negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: The interaction signal fails when both HOUST and GDPC1 decline but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In high-unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 9.5%), a declining unemployment rate signals labor market improvement, boosting consumer confidence and generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE > 9.5 and UNRATE declines.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) above 600 thousand units indicate strengthening consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as the market anticipates consumption growth.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when HOUST exceeds 600.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly INDPRO decline below 100 signals manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate earnings expectations and producing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO falls below 100.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous FEDFUNDS decline and CPIAUCSL rise above 218.0 indicates policy uncertainty, increasing equity risk premiums and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: The interaction signal fails when FEDFUNDS < 0.2 and CPIAUCSL > 218.0 but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In low-employment-growth regimes (PAYEMS growth < 0.5% monthly), a declining UNRATE signals labor market recovery, increasing consumer spending and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when PAYEMS growth < 0.5% and UNRATE declines.
